entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-04-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Known Build Error] GivenAGetDependsOnNETStandardTask.SucceedsWithWarningOnLockedFile flaky failure #53870

  • Delete unused resources from CliCommandStrings #53856
  • [StaticWebAssets] Zstd compression and Compression Dictionary Transport (CDT) support #53855
  • Missing libraries when using CopyLocalLockFileAssemblies #53854

Closed

  • `dotnet run` writes the "Using launch settings from ..." message to stdout instead of stderr #45640
    Backlog
  • `PackageReference` doesn't work when under `Condition` dependent on `Configuration` in a project referenced by another project with both being built with `dotnet build solution.sln` #53672
  • `dotnet run --file` often fails claiming it can't load a non-existent .csproj #52714
    10.0.3xx
